KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WELCOMETOSPERANZA: Welcome to Speranza! Now that you're settled in, Shani has asked for you to come by her room.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PREPAREFORTOPSIDE: You’ll have to go topside to help out Shani.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PREPARELOADOUT: Prepare your loadout before heading out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_EQUIPWEAPON: A selection of basic gear has been equipped to your loadout. Make sure to equip your weapon to your weapon slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FIRSTDEPLOY: With your loadout prepared, you are ready to head topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CHARACTERSCREEN: You can improve your Raider on the Character screen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SKILLTREE: The Skill Tree lets you unlock and improve abilities.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SKILLTREEBRANCHES: Each skill improves different aspects of your Raider. They can be used to cater to your preferred playstyle.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_QUESTREWARD: NPCs will reward you for your help. Head back to claim your reward.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_UNLOADBACKPACK: Make sure to unload your backpack before heading back up.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ANYTHINGLOST: Anything you bring topside can be lost if you’re knocked out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ESSENTIALITEM: {0} will help you face the dangers of the Topside. Add it to your loadout before you deploy.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_QUICKUSESLOTS: Items like bandages and explosives can only be used if they’re in your Quick Use slots.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WORKSHOPINTRO: Use stations to craft items and gear. You'll have to build specialized stations for more advanced crafting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SCRAPPY: Scrappy, your loyal rooster, will gather basic supplies while you're topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SCRAPPYCOLLECT: Collect Scrappy's supplies to help you craft some basic gear.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_BASICBENCH: Your workshop comes with a Workbench. Use it to craft essentials like ammo, bandages and augments.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CRAFTAMMO: Craft some basic supplies for the next time you go topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CRAFTAMMOCOMPLETE: All done! Your supplies have been added to your stash.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_QUESTREWARDREMINDE: Make sure to claim your quest reward.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MAPSCREEN: New maps are unlocked over time. Every map comes with its own risks and rewards.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONDURABILITY: Your weapon's durability degrades with use. Be sure to repair it before it breaks.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_TRADERRUN: If you're low on gear, the Free Loadout lets you go topside with a set of low-level equipment.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONREPAIR_MOUSE: Right-click on your weapon to repair it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MAPCONDITIONS: Maps conditions alter the state of a map during a set period of time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_RAIDERFLARE: Bright red flares indicate a Raider getting knocked out. Approach at your own risk.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_LOOTING_01: Useful loot can be found scattered around the world. Some can be used immediately, while others can help you craft new gear and supplies.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_BREACHING_0: Some doors require breaching to open. They may protect valuable loot, but the noise can attract unwanted attention.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_JUMP: Press to jump or vault over an obstacle
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PREPARELOADOUTPLAY: Press Play to prepare your loadout before heading out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WORKSHOPCALLOUT: Your workshop lets you craft items and gear.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTSLOST: Augments can be lost just like any item. You can craft new ones in your workshop, or loot them while topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTSINTRO: Augments let you change the slots in your loadout.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTNEWBIE: Equip the Rookie Augment to unlock additional Safe Pockets.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CHALLENGESCRED: Complete Feats to earn Cred. You can use Cred to claim rewards from the Raider Deck.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FREEHARDCURRENCY: For participating in the ARC Raiders Tech Test, you've been granted free Raider Tokens. Use them to purchase a deck of your choice.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONREPAIR_GENER: Open the More Actions menu to repair your weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_OINBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONREPAIR_GAME: Hold {0} with your weapon selected to repair it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FREEUPSPACE: Your Stash is full. You can free up space in your stash by selling items from the More Actions menu.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_STATIONUPGRADE: Upgrade your station to unlock new capabilities.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONUPGRADE_GENE: Open the More Actions menu to upgrade your weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONUPGRADE_MOUS: Right-click on your weapon to upgrade it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONUPGRADE_GAME: Hold {0} with your weapon selected to upgrade it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_TRADERGIFT: One of the Traders has a welcome gift for you.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MODS_LONG: Open the Inspect screen from the More Actions menu to apply mods to your weapon. Mods let you alter your weapon's behavior.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MODS_SHORT_INSPECT: Open the Inspect screen from the More Actions menu to apply mods to your weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MODS_SHORT_ALTERBE: Mods let you alter your weapon's behavior.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_MODSLOT: Equip mods to your weapon's mod slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_JUMP: jump or vault over an obstacle
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PROMPT_MELEE: Press to swing your Raider Tool
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_STASHINGUP: Looted materials can be turned into useful resources
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_CRAFTINGBAN: Fabric can be used to craft Bandages
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_EQUIP: Only gear equipped to your loadout can be used
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_HEALING_01: Hold to select a healing item from your Quick Use wheel
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_HEALING_01_: select a healing item from your Quick Use wheel
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_KORAIDERS: Knocked-out Raiders may carry valuable gear or loot, but approach with caution.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_ELEVATOR_01: Use the panel to call a Cargo Elevator
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_ELEVATOR_02: The Cargo Elevator takes some time to arrive. Stay aware of your surroundings: the noise may attract enemies to your location.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_ELEVATOR_03: Use the computer inside the elevator to get to safety.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FREEBATTLEPASS: For participating in the ARC Raiders Tech Test, you've been granted a free deck.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_FIELDCRAFTI: Craft an Improvised Bandage to heal yourself
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_ENCOUNTERRA: Strangers you encounter may be friendly or hostile. Always be on your guard.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_RECOVERINGH: Topside is full of dangers. You'll need to recover your health to make it back to safety.
Loot containers may contain bandages and gear to help you get back on your feet.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_SAFEPOCKET: Move items to your Safe Pocket to retain them if you're knocked out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CANGOBACK: You can go to the topside anytime now, I have more for you when you come back to speranza.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPON_CATEGORY: Use the Weapon filter to find a weapon to equip.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENT_CATEGORY: Use the Augment filter to find an Augment to equip.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ARMORSLOT: Shields deflect some of the damage you take. They are equipped to the Shield slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_TOPSIDE: Press Play to prepare for going topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_EQUIPAUGMENT: Equip an augment to alter the slots available in your loadout.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SCRAPPYCRAFT: Return to your workshop to craft with Scrappy's supplies
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_BATTLEPASS: You have unlocked the Raider Deck, allowing you to earn additional rewards.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ARMOR: Shields deflect some of the damage you take.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ARMOREQUIP: Equip a Shield by putting it in your Shield slot.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTS: Use augments to cater your loadout to your preferred playstyle.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONARMORDURABIL: Weapons and Shields degrade with use. Be sure to repair them before they break.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ARMOR_CATEGORY: Use the Shield filter to find a Shield to equip.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTINVENTORY: Equip your augment from the Inventory screen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_BRINGSHIELD: Make sure to bring a Shield for added protection while topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FIRSTREADYUP: With your loadout prepared, press Ready Up to head topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FIRSTDEPLOY_GENERI: With everything prepared, get ready to go topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FIRSTMAP: The Map screen lets you choose your destination. Some maps need to be unlocked before you're able to deploy there.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_RAIDERSCREEN: You can improve and customize your Raider on the Raider screen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_RAIDERDENSCREEN: You can improve your Raider on the Raider Den screen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_STO: Stow your weapon to sprint faster — but keep an eye on your stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_EMO: Use emotes to communicate with others.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_EQU: Open the quick use wheel to equip a healing item.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_MAP: Open the map to plan your route.
Your map helps you find your way around Topside, and highlights promising loot spots.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_PIN: Pinging helps you plan your route, and coordinate with your squad mates.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_ENERGYAMMO_: Reloading a partially loaded energy weapon will consume the entire energy clip.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_INROUNDCRAF: In-Round Crafting can be accessed through the Crafting tab next to the Inventory tab.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_ACCEPTQUEST: Accept the quest from Shani and go topside
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PLAYTOGETHER_OPTIN: Enable Fill Squad to automatically find squadmates to collaborate with.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_PLAYTOGETHER_OPTOU: Fill Squad lets you automatically find squadmates to collaborate with. Turn off Fill Squad to instead embark on a solo round.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WORKSHOP_SCRAPPY: Head to your Workshop to visit Scrappy, and see what supplies it has gathered for you.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WORKSHOP_INTRO_ALT: Your Workshop lets you craft items and gear. Scrappy, your loyal rooster, will gather basic supplies while you're topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WORKSHOP_INTRO_RET: Return to your Workshop to craft additional items and gear.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CRAFTAUGMENT_ALT2: Augments let you adjust your loadout to your preferred tactics, and few Raiders go topside without one. Use your Workbench to craft an Augment
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CRAFTAUGMENT: Augments let you adjust your loadout to your preferred tactics. Craft an augment for the next time you go topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_EQUIPWEAPON_ALT2: Equip your weapon by putting it in your weapon slot. Make sure that the ammo in your inventory matches your equipped weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_NEW_DESTINATION: A new destination has been unlocked.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CODEX_RAIDERTAB_TO: Go to the Raider screen to check out the Codex.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CODEX_BACK: Return to the Raider screen to view your Codex.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CODEX_RAIDERDEN: Press this button to check out Codex
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_CODEX: The Codex automatically documents your learnings and experiences.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTSINTRO_ALT2: Augments can be used to cater your loadout to your preferred playstyle, and most Raiders refuse to go topside without. Equip an augment to alter the slots available in your loadout.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_AUGMENTSABOUT: Augments can be lost just like any item. You can craft new ones in your workshop, or loot them while topside. All augments have their own strengths, and cater to different playstyles.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SHIELDDURABILITY: Your shield's durability degrades with use. It will soon break.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_SHIELDDURABILITY_A: Shields degrade with use. It will soon break. Open the More Actions menu to repair your shield.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONDURABILITY_A: Weapons degrade with use. Be sure to repair them before they break. Open the More Actions menu to repair your weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_WEAPONARMORDURABIL: Weapons and Shields degrade with use. Be sure to repair them before they break. Open the More Actions menu to repair your weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_EXPANDSTASH: Your Stash is full. Expand your Stash size to fit more items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FREEUPSPACE_ALT2: You can also free up space in the Stash by selling items in the More Actions menu.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FREEUPSPACE_SELLRE: Your Stash is full. You can free up space in your stash by selling or recycling items from the More Actions menu.
You can also free up space in the stash by selling or recycling items in the More Actions menu.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_OPENINVENTORY: You always have quick access to your inventory.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_DESCRIPTIVENPX_STO: Stow what you are holding to move faster — but keep an eye on your stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_FIELDCRAFTING_DESC: You've unlocked field crafting! A Crafting tab is now available in the Inventory screen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_LEARNRECIPE: Learning a blueprint will allow you to craft a new item in your Workshop. The blueprint itself will be consumed.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_CROU: Crouching lets you move through tight spaces and hide behind low cover.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_VAUL: Vaulting lets you move up tall obstacles and reach higher grounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_JUMP: Jumping lets you get across narrow gaps.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_SPRI: Sprinting lets you reposition quickly, but costs stamina and makes a lot of noise.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_SLID: While sprinting, you can use the crouch input to enter a slide.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_FLAS: Use your flashlight to see better in dark areas.
KeysToEntries.ID_ONBOARDINGTOOLTIPS_INGAME_PROMPT_HEAL: Healing items can be equipped through the Quick Use wheel.
